title: 第13章 识伪草谋灵药第15章 签20年卖身契
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神

咯吱一声，李安打开了房门。
然后就看到一名身形修长，脸上带着几分正人君子气息的青年。
孙乾！
这孙子行事极为霸道，却因为背后有关系，容貌又相当不错，在外门很吃得开。
见李安打开了房门，孙乾笑了笑，翻手从怀里摸出一个瓷瓶，递给了李安。
“老规矩，买了这炼灵丸，吞服之后，有机会提升你的灵根，师兄我这也是为你好！”
李安看了一眼瓷瓶内的丹丸。
只是蕴含极为微弱的灵气，比起丹炉中那些蕴含灵气的废丹都不如，很明显，是只用了一些草药胡乱糊弄出来的。
别说是三块灵石，就是一两银子都不值，对修士压根就没有丝毫提升。
表面上是买卖，实际上却是强买强卖。
以往李安不过是炼气一层，又没有什么背景，就算不忿，也只能压着心中的火气。
可现在，他已然突破到了炼气三层。
甚至修行的八品上功法，凝聚出的灵气更是远超外门的弟子。
就是兰月儿那样的火工童子，都是自己的奴仆，孙乾还想强买强卖？
李安眼神一冷，孙乾顿时感觉头皮发麻，有种被凶残猛兽锁定的错觉，忍不住退后了一步。
怎么回事？
为什么李安这个老实人，眼神这么可怕？
“李安，你不过是炼气一层的废物，也敢用这个眼神看我？”
孙乾抬手将手中的瓷瓶收了回去，身上有淡淡的赤红灵气流转，一脸傲气地盯着李安，“我已经修成了九品上的《火灵决》，便是炼气四层的修士都碰一碰，今日这灵石你不想交也得交！”

虽然依旧是炼气三层，可是有门路，再加上耗费了一些灵石，前段时间也是有机会修行九品上的火灵决，并且将此法修行入门。
凝聚出了九品火灵气，实力有了很大的提升。
在外门大部分弟子都修行不入流功法的情况下，就是遇到没有背景的炼气四层师兄，他也是有把握依靠功法的强大，与其抗衡。
所以，被李安一个眼神逼退，简直就是巨大的耻辱！
九品上火灵气席卷而来，如热浪拂面，带来阵阵灼热之感。
“就这水平？”
李安微微摇头，这种品阶的灵气，在一众外门底层弟子当中的确算是鹤立鸡群了。
可在他的八品上灵魄之气面前，却像是个笑话。
只是，在他刚准备出手之际，李安鼻子动了动，淡淡的熏香味道扑面而来，他的视线忽然落在了孙乾收回手中的药丸上。
“这药丸是用采药峰培育出来的锻灵草捣鼓的？”李安忽然饶有兴趣地追问道。
听到这话，孙乾愣了一下，不知道李安为何有此一问。
不过李安似乎对这药丸很有兴趣，也就暂且压下了心中的火气，点头道：
“算你识货，这药丸就是用锻灵草精心炼制而出，此种灵药极为难得，便是炼丹师需要，都需要限额，若非是看你有缘，这种好东西，我可是不会卖给你！”
李安轻笑一声。
这孙乾真当自己什么都不知道？
真正的锻灵草的确极为珍贵，有着些许淬炼、提升灵根的作用。

With a creak, Li An opened the door.
Then he saw a young man with a slender figure and a somewhat gentlemanly air on his face.
Sun Qian!
This grandson acts very domineeringly, but because of his connections behind the scenes and his good looks, he is very popular in the outside world.
Seeing Li An open the door, Sun Qian smiled, took out a porcelain bottle from his arms, and handed it to Li An.
"Old rules, buy this spirit refining pill, and after swallowing it, you will have the opportunity to improve your spiritual roots. Senior brother, I am doing this for your own good!"
Li An glanced at the pills in the porcelain bottle.
It only contains extremely weak spiritual energy, which is not as good as the waste pills containing spiritual energy in the alchemy furnace. It is obvious that it was just made with some herbs.
Not to mention three spiritual stones, even one tael of silver is not worth it, and it does not improve the monk at all.
On the surface it is buying and selling, but in reality it is forced buying and selling.
In the past, Li An was only at the first level of Qi Refining and had no background. Even if he wasn't angry, he could only suppress the anger in his heart.
But now, he has broken through to the third level of Qi Refining.
Even the spiritual energy condensed by practicing the eighth-grade upper-level skills is far superior to that of the outer disciples.
Even a pyrotechnic boy like Lan Yue'er is his slave, and Sun Qian still wants to buy and sell by force?
Li An's eyes turned cold, and Sun Qian suddenly felt his scalp numb. He had the illusion that he was being targeted by a ferocious beast, and couldn't help but take a step back.
What's going on?
Why does Li An, an honest man, have such scary eyes?
"Li An, you are just a waste at the first level of Qi refining, how dare you look at me like this?"
Sun Qian raised his hand and took back the porcelain bottle in his hand. There was a faint red spiritual energy flowing around his body. He stared at Li An with an arrogant expression, "I have completed the ninth-level "Fire Spirit Art". Even the monks on the fourth level of Qi Refining have touched it. You have to hand over this spirit stone today if you don't want to!"
Although he is still at the third level of Qi refining, he has a way and spent some spirit stones. Some time ago, he had the opportunity to practice the fire spirit art at the ninth level, and got started with this method.
The ninth-grade fire spirit energy was condensed, and the strength was greatly improved.
When most of the disciples in the outer sect were practicing unqualified martial arts, even if he encountered a fourth-level Qi Refining senior who had no background, he could rely on the power of his martial arts to compete with them.
Therefore, being forced to retreat by Ang Lee's look was simply a huge shame!
The ninth-grade high-fire spiritual energy swept over him, like a heat wave on his face, bringing bursts of burning sensation.
"That's it?"
Li An shook his head slightly. This level of spiritual energy was indeed outstanding among the low-level disciples of the outer sect.
But in front of his eighth-grade spiritual energy, it seemed like a joke.
However, just when he was about to take action, Li An's nose moved, and the faint smell of incense came to his face. His eyes suddenly fell on the pills that Sun Qian took back.
"Is this pill made from the spirit-forging grass cultivated in the Medicine Peak?" Li An suddenly asked with interest.
Hearing this, Sun Qian was stunned for a moment, wondering why Li An asked this.
However, Li An seemed to be very interested in this pill, so he temporarily suppressed his anger and nodded:
"You know what I'm selling? This pill is carefully refined from Spirit Forging Grass. This kind of elixir is extremely rare. Even if an alchemist needs it, it has a quota. If it weren't for your fate, I wouldn't sell this good thing to you!"
Li An chuckled.
Does Sun Qian really think he knows nothing?
The real spirit-forging grass is indeed extremely precious and has the effect of tempering and improving spiritual roots.
